title: Critique: commonsense psychology is not a quasi-scientific theory

statements.text: In a tradition from Wittgenstein and Ryle, commonsense psychology is not a quasi-scientific theory for explaining behavior and does not treat beliefs as discrete inner causes. On Dennett's view, propositional attitudes are real abstracta used in taking a stance toward rational agents, not candidates for reduction or elimination by cognitive science.

sources.quote: common sense psychology is not a quasi-scientific theory used to explain or predict behavior, nor does it treat mental states like beliefs as discrete inner causes of behavior
